items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 84:1
items.html: The first cause is the rise of MAN of YESHSUT to AVI for the need of the Mochin of Gadlut, at which time all the upper Partzufim likewise raise MAN up to AB SAG of AK, as above in Answer 156.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 84:2
items.html: The second cause is the coupling of AB SAG upon the MAN raised to them, and a new light was drawn to them from Ein Sof, and there came out there a complete level upon this MAN, called Mochin, or MAD. For the aspect of the screens and coarseness included in the records are called by the name MAN, and the level of the ten Sefirot that comes out upon the MAN is called by the name MAD. And the illumination of this MAD descended until it reached Atik and its Nukva of Atzilut.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 84:3
items.html: The third cause is the descent of the drop of MAD in Atik down to the coupling of Yesod and Atara, which annuls all the Parsaot of Atzilut that were made from the root of the rise of the bottom Hey in Einayim, namely the Parsa in the “belly and its innards,” which is likewise the aspect of the membrane beneath the Moach Stimaa, and the aspect of the screen of Yesod, and the aspect of the Parsa of the ending of all Atzilut, standing between Atzilut and Beria.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 84:4
items.html: The fourth cause is the annulment of the Parsaot: through the annulment of the Parsa between Atzilut and Beria, the lower thirds of Atik rose from BYA, together with the aspect of Rosh and Guf of ZON, which are the secret of Vav and a dot, to the place of the middle thirds of Atik, where the NHY of AA stand; and also, through the annulment of the Parsa in the “belly and its innards” of Atik, Atik and AA united and became one Partzuf.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 84:5
items.html: The fifth cause is the return of AA and Atik to one Partzuf, which brought about four things: First, that the NHY of AA became the aspect of the NHY of Atik, through which they rose to the place of its HGT, where the NHY of Atik stand; so the Yesod of AA is found to end equally with the Yesod of Atik, namely at the place of the chest of AA. Second, that this whole place, which was in the aspect of HGT, meaning in covered Hassadim, was turned and became the aspect of revealed Hassadim, since the NHY of AA now took hold of this whole place from the Peh to the chest. Third, that the Yesod of AA now comes to the Yesodot of AVI, since, through the Yesod of AA becoming the Yesod of Atik ending at the place of the chest of AA, that is the place of the aspect of the Yesodot of AVI, as above in Answer 153. Fourth, that the Rosh and Guf of ZON, which were attached to the Yesod and Atara of Arich Anpin, rose together with this Yesod and Atara to the place of the Yesodot of AVI, namely to the place of the chest, where the Yesodot of AVI now clothe upon the Yesod of AA.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 84:6
items.html: The sixth cause is the drop of MAD of AB of AK, which descended also to the Moach Stimaa of AA, so that AA too coupled in the secret of palate and throat, called the coupling of kissing, from where it reached AVI as well, and they too coupled in the coupling of kissing; and then they lowered the bottom Hey from the Einayim of YESHSUT, and they received new Mochin and NHY, namely that YESHSUT raised their fallen AHP, and with them also the aspect of Rosh and Guf of the portion of ZON attached to their AHP. It is thus found now that all the portions of ZON have already risen, since the NHY of AA raised with them the Rosh and Guf of its own portion, namely from the secret of Vav and a dot; and the new AHP of YESHSUT raised the Rosh and Guf of the portion of ZON from the aspect of their portion from the time of Nekudim. And all three aspects of the Rosh and Guf of ZON now stand in the three Yesodot of AA, Aba, and Ima, clothed one within the other. You already know that Yisrael Saba is included in Aba, and Tevunah is included in Ima, as above in Answer 157.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 84:7
items.html: The seventh cause is that the drop of kissing of Aba, which is AB, descended to his Yesod, which is the aspect of 32 NTH, and descended and refined the dross that was in the 320 sparks, which are the 32 Malchuts, and brought them down as refuse, and selected from them only 288 sparks, which are the secret of the white in the offspring, since they are the aspect of the very essence of the Sefirot of ZA, from the aspect of the line and a half on the right, meaning that the left line is absent from them, which is the aspect of the bottom Hey mixed into the ten Sefirot, as above in Answer 135. The reason is that Aba had already brought down every aspect of the Malchuts within him, which are of the aspect of judgment and dross, upon which there is no aspect of a screen, so that all the Sefirot of ZA are found entirely clean of the aspect of Malchuts; therefore it is considered the aspect of the right line of the ten Sefirot alone, without any coarseness of the bottom Hey — and this is the secret that Aba gives the white within it. And Ima also couples from the aspect of her Katnut, namely from the aspect of the bottom Hey in Einayim remaining in her from the time of Katnut, and then Ima gives the illumination of her five Gevurot to the 288 sparks, so that the bottom Hey of the clothing remaining in the 288 sparks is thickened by the five Gevurot of Ima, and passes through all the ten Sefirot of ZA, and makes in them the line and a half on the left. And the aspect of the coupling of Aba, which corrects the line and a half on the right, is called the first day of the days of absorption; and the aspect of the coupling of Ima, which corrects the line and a half on the left, is called the second day of the days of absorption. And after this, AVI couple with one another, and then these lines of AVI join together, which is the aspect of the third day of the days of absorption.
